topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: So, here I am, listening to this coincidence that's supposed to be charming or heartwarming. My child ends up with the same teacher I had decades ago. Isn't that just dandy? It's like the world is conspiring to draw these pointless, circular connections. I'm supposed to be nostalgic, to see it as some sort of cosmic wink. But all I can think about is the wasted time, the inevitable stories I'll have to pretend are interesting, and the hollow smiles this will require. It's just one more thing to add to the pile of manufactured moments we're all supposed to cherish. I can almost hear the daggers grinding behind the camaraderie. Well, isn’t life just a delightful charade?
